topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't shake the sense that the world has suddenly grown a little too small. We started chatting online, worlds apart, sharing laughs and stories that felt safe, confined to screens and text. Finding out they're right here, just blocks away, twists things. I've been replaying our conversations, scanning for clues I might have missed. Is this a coincidence, or something more? The thought of bumping into them now, face-to-face, sends a chill through me. I thought I knew the boundaries of our connection, but now those lines blur, and I'm not sure where to go from here. Maybe I'll reach out, maybe I won't. For now, I just need some space to sort this out.
